headline: More Investments in U.S. Space Sector Are Coming, Linde Says
summary: Industrial gases provider Linde plans to increase investments in its space sector, the company’s chief executive said Thursday. Linde manufactures the industrial gases, like liquid oxygen and hydrogen, that help propel these rockets into space.

summary: WOKING, England, February 05, 2026--Linde plc (Nasdaq: LIN) today reported fourth-quarter 2025 net income of $1,530 million and diluted earnings per share of $3.26, down 11% and 9%, respectively. Excluding Linde AG purchase accounting impacts and restructuring charge impacts, adjusted net income was $1,968 million, up 4% versus prior year. Adjusted earnings per share was $4.20, 6% above prior year.
